full_text:
Rag Armor

Introduction. Rag Armor is a Meadows-tier armor and the most basic armor that can be acquired. It is statistically inferior to Leather Armor, and provides minimal protection. There are no set bonuses for rag armor. Every player starts with a Rag Tunic equipped.

Armor pieces. This set of armor has two pieces which are crafted and upgraded at the Workbench.
